page_title: WOL 1-3 MAI | Wolfsburg v Mainz 18/05/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' That's it for today, Frank Willenborg has blown his whistle and the game is over.
90+5' Today's match ends for Nadiem Amiri who will be replaced by Marco Richter (Mainz).
90+5' Substitution. Jonathan Burkardt is replaced by Josuha Guilavogui (Mainz).
90+3' Nadiem Amiri (Mainz) works the corner short.
90' 7 additional min. will be played.
89' Dominik Kohr (Mainz) is awarded a yellow card. The referee showed him no mercy.
87' Frank Willenborg blows his whistle and it's Bennit Broger (Wolfsburg) who is penalised for an offensive foul. Good decision by the referee.
87' It's time for a substitution. Tom Krauss (Mainz) comes on in place of Brajan Gruda.
85' 1 - 3 It's a goal! Brajan Gruda sends a long raking pass onto the head of Jonathan Burkardt (Mainz), who makes no mistake from close in and sends the ball low into the middle of the net. 1:3.
80' Ralph Hasenhuttl is forced to make an unplanned substitution as Patrick Wimmer suffers an injury and Bennit Broger (Wolfsburg) comes on.
77' Patrick Wimmer (Wolfsburg) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
76' Here is a change. Jonas Wind is going off and Ralph Hasenhuttl gives the last tactical orders to Kevin Behrens (Wolfsburg).
76' Ralph Hasenhuttl has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Vaclav Cerny (Wolfsburg) replacing Ridle Baku.
73' Bo Henriksen has decided to substitute Silvan Widmer and he is replaced by Anthony Caci (Mainz).
73' That's the end of the game for Jae-Sung Lee, who is replaced by Ludovic Ajorque (Mainz).

71' Sepp van den Berg (Mainz) leaps highest around the penalty spot to meet a cross from the free kick and produces a promising goal-bound header towards the right post, but Koen Casteels pulls off a fine save to deny him.
71' Lovro Majer (Wolfsburg) takes his opponent down and receives a yellow card from the referee.
71' 1 - 2 Goal 1:2! Sepp van den Berg (Mainz) taps home from close range after the rebound fell kindly into his path.

70' Patrick Wimmer (Wolfsburg) makes a yard for himself on the edge of the box and produces a poor effort that sails miles wide of the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Mainz.
68' Some neat passing and movement from Wolfsburg as they ping around some short passes in order to create a new attacking opportunity.
66' Lovro Majer (Wolfsburg) is penalised for a foul. Frank Willenborg had a clear view and blows his whistle.
66' Nadiem Amiri (Mainz) hasn't suffered any serious injury which would see him leave the pitch. He's back in the game now.
65' The game is interrupted now, Nadiem Amiri (Mainz) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
62' Close! Brajan Gruda (Mainz) unleashes a rocket of a shot from the edge of the box and his shot flies just a few inches over the crossbar.
60' Nadiem Amiri (Mainz) crosses the ball from the free kick, but it goes out of play.
58' Jae-Sung Lee (Mainz) plays a dangerous chip pass into the box in an attempt to set up one of his teammates, but the effort is intercepted by one of the defenders.
57' Patrick Wimmer (Wolfsburg) produces a dangerous low pass into the penalty area, but the defence manage to cut it out.
55' Jonas Wind (Wolfsburg) beats his marker in the air and aims a header at goal from the free kick, but the close-range effort flashes just over the bar.
54' Andreas Hanche-Olsen (Mainz) will miss the next game because of that yellow card.
54' Andreas Hanche-Olsen (Mainz) shouldn't be surprised it's a yellow from the ref, who cooled the situation down well.
52' Nadiem Amiri (Mainz) sends in a lofted cross from a mid-range free kick. His effort, however, goes out of play. The ball goes out of play and Wolfsburg will have a goal kick.
52' Patrick Wimmer (Wolfsburg) commits a foul and is shown a yellow card without any hesitation from the referee.
50' The foul by Kilian Fischer (Wolfsburg) was seen by Frank Willenborg who didn't hesitate to blow the whistle.
49' One of the players from Mainz times his run too early and the referee blows his whistle for offside.
46' Nadiem Amiri (Mainz) steps up to take the corner. He launches the ball into the penalty area, but it only finds the head of an opposing player who clears the danger.
46' Ralph Hasenhuttl makes a half-time substitution. Patrick Wimmer comes on in place of Kevin Paredes (Wolfsburg).
46' The second half has just started.
45+4' Frank Willenborg has ended the first half by blowing the whistle.
45+3' Jonas Wind (Wolfsburg) commits a foul and Frank Willenborg immediately signals a free kick.

45+1' Maxence Lacroix (Wolfsburg) jumps highest to head the ball from the resulting free kick on the edge of the box! A difficult position to score from and the keeper reacts coolly to make a comfortable save.
45' 3 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
45' Frank Willenborg has a clear sight and sees a foul from Nadiem Amiri (Mainz). That's a free kick to Wolfsburg.
44' Leandro Barreiro (Mainz) shoots from the edge of the penalty area. The ball travels towards the middle of the target, but Koen Casteels easily deals with the threat.
42' A horde of players are waiting inside the penalty area for a cross from the corner, but Nadiem Amiri (Mainz) takes it short.

42' Leandro Barreiro (Mainz) has a sight of goal, fires a shot in from distance towards the left post and forces a good save out of Koen Casteels. Mainz will have a chance to score from a corner kick.
41' Jonas Wind (Wolfsburg) launches into a thunderous tackle on his opponent and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.

39' Sebastiaan Bornauw (Wolfsburg) should know this behaviour is beyond the rules. He was too careless with his challenge and left Frank Willenborg no option but to blow his whistle. Mainz are awarded a free kick. Let's see what they create from this.
36' Nadiem Amiri (Mainz) lacks options so fires a shot at goal from the edge of box, but it's a wasted effort and goes high over the bar.
36' Phillipp Mwene (Mainz) attempted to create a dangerous situation in front of goal by sending a cross into the box, but the defence easily dealt with the threat.

35' Phillipp Mwene (Mainz) wastes a great chance as he climbs high around the penalty spot to connect with a cross from the resulting free kick. He produces a header which goes just over the crossbar.
35' Sebastiaan Bornauw (Wolfsburg) makes a reckless foul in order to win the ball from his opponent. Frank Willenborg has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle.
33' PENALTY APPEAL by Mainz, but the referee thinks it was a fair challenge and play continues!
31' Nadiem Amiri (Mainz) blasts the ball high over the crossbar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Wolfsburg.
31' Brajan Gruda (Mainz) has the ability to send the ball deep into the penalty area from throw-ins and it can lead to very promising situations for his team.
30' Let's have a look at statistics for the fouls committed by both teams – 1:7.
28' Jakub Kaminski (Wolfsburg) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Robin Zentner, who smothers the ball.
27' Wolfsburg can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
26' Jonas Wind (Wolfsburg) unleashes a bullet of a shot that is blocked by a defender.

24' 1 - 1 Nadiem Amiri passes to Brajan Gruda (Mainz), who collects the ball and unleashes a terrific shot from the edge of the box. His effort goes into the bottom right corner. Fabulous goal! The score is 1:1.
24' Maxence Lacroix (Wolfsburg) has picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue.
24' Maximilian Arnold (Wolfsburg) tries his luck from a long-range free kick and fires the ball to the left side of the goal, but Robin Zentner is alert and thwarts the effort.
22' Maxence Lacroix (Wolfsburg) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
21' Frank Willenborg blows for a foul after Jonathan Burkardt (Mainz) was too aggressive in the battle for the ball. A free kick to Wolfsburg.
18' 1 - 0 Goal! Jakub Kaminski puts a cross into the box and finds Kevin Paredes (Wolfsburg), who latches on to it and strikes the ball into the bottom left corner. He makes it 1:0.
16' Kevin Paredes (Wolfsburg) tries to latch onto a through ball, but it's too long. The ball is out of play. Mainz will have a throw-in.
14' Maximilian Arnold (Wolfsburg) runs onto a rebound and unleashes a piledriver from distance that flies just wide of the right post.
12' Jae-Sung Lee (Mainz) has to be very careful for the rest of the match after receiving a yellow card from the referee for a bad tackle on an opponent.
10' Silvan Widmer (Mainz) is deemed to be in an offside position by the linesman and it looks like it is the right decision despite being a very close call.
8' Maximilian Arnold (Wolfsburg) seems to have picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue playing.
8' Maximilian Arnold (Wolfsburg) picks up an injury.
6' The free kick finds Jonas Wind (Wolfsburg) in space in the box, but he can't keep his header down and sends it just over the bar from close range.
6' Dominik Kohr (Mainz) commits an ugly tackle on his opponent, but there is no caution from the referee. Wolfsburg have a free kick.
4' Jonathan Burkardt (Mainz) gets on the ball and beats an opponent, but his run is stopped by the referee Frank Willenborg who sees an offensive foul.
2' Jonathan Burkardt (Mainz) makes space inside the box for a shot, but his effort goes just wide of the right post.
1' There's a melee in the box, but the referee isn't interested in the appeals from Wolfsburg for a penalty. Play continues.
1' Here we go, today's match is starting right now.
The players are on the pitch and Wolfsburg will have the kick-off.
Frank Willenborg is introduced as the referee for today's match.
Welcome to our live text coverage. We will try to provide you with a detailed image of what's happening on the pitch. There are only few moments left to the beginning of the match.
